prompt:
Redesign this generated character into a visibly DIFFERENT original adult anime heroine, while preserving the successful drawing language of the eyes, minimal nose/mouth, thin colored face contours and crisp cel shadows. One polished portrait, head and shoulders, upright front view, entire hair top visible with margin. Plain pale warm-gray background. A clearly adult woman around 27. Fully clothed charcoal collared shirt with a subtle cream inner collar edge, ordinary modern clothing.

Change the identity, not merely the colors: dark chestnut-red collarbone-length asymmetric bob, clean blunt ends with a small outward flip at shoulder level. Side-swept broken fringe covers about one third of forehead, NOT a large open forehead, and NOT the long central lock from the reference. One side tucked neatly behind the ear, NO braid, no long trailing curls. Warm amber irises. Slightly broader lower cheeks and a softly tapered jaw, slightly straighter eyebrows; right eyebrow subtly raised, a very small confident asymmetrical closed-mouth smile. Head upright instead of reference tilt.

Preserve moderately open horizontally elongated almond eyes, heavy black upper eyelid wedges with elegant outward taper, delicate lower lash marks and detailed luminous irises. Compact stylized nose-to-mouth region: nose only a tiny colored dot/short mark, no long nose bridge shadow; small fine-line mouth without rendered lips. Face must stay unequivocally adult through composed expression and mature proportions, not chibi or childlike. Keep soft cheek warmth, two or three intentional cel shadow values and clean pale highlights. Hair highlights broad and graphic, hair masses rich dark chestnut, no silver or blue hair. Avoid long midface, oversized forehead, sharp triangular chin, glossy lips, photorealism, painterly blur, flat lifeless skin, plastic 3D rendering. The attraction is the graphic eye expression and subtle face planes. Do not reproduce the reference person's hair silhouette, color combination, costume or pose. No text or watermark.
visual_review: Chestnut bob, amber eyes and charcoal shirt distinguish the silhouette and palette. Compact nose/mouth and expressive eyelids retained. Head tilt and top crop remain; fringe crosses one eye. Aesthetic candidate, not final model sheet or guarantee of originality.
